title: Electric Kettles: Gooseneck, Variable Temp and Budget
metaDescription: Our electric kettle research: the best kettles for tea, pour-over coffee and everyday boiling, plus a temperature guide.
lede: A good kettle boils fast, pours cleanly and, if you drink tea or pour-over coffee, lets you pick the exact temperature.

p: Most readers should start with the best electric kettles list. If you brew green tea or pour-over coffee, the buying guide explains why variable temperature matters.
